tools.name: useresponse_get_current_user
tools.description: Get the user that owns the API key: name, role and team. Good first call to check the connection. UseResponse API: GET /me.json.

tools.name: useresponse_search_objects
tools.description: Search feedback topics and help desk tickets by text, status, category, author, date or type. UseResponse API: GET /search.json.

tools.name: useresponse_list_tickets
tools.description: List help desk tickets, with filters for status, responsible agent, forum, author email and completion. UseResponse API: GET /tickets.json.

tools.name: useresponse_get_object
tools.description: Get one ticket or topic by id. UseResponse API: GET /objects/{id}.json.

tools.name: useresponse_get_object_comments
tools.description: List the comments on one ticket or topic. UseResponse API: GET /objects/{id}/comments.json.

tools.name: useresponse_list_comments
tools.description: List comments across the account, filtered by date or privacy. UseResponse API: GET /comments.json.

tools.name: useresponse_get_object_changelog
tools.description: Get the change history of one ticket or topic. UseResponse API: GET /changelog/object/{id}.json.

tools.name: useresponse_list_object_custom_fields
tools.description: List the custom fields defined for tickets and topics. UseResponse API: GET /objects/custom-fields/list.json.

tools.name: useresponse_search_users
tools.description: Search customers and staff by name, email, phone, team or status. UseResponse API: GET /users/search.json.

tools.name: useresponse_get_user
tools.description: Get one user by id, with role, team, custom fields and registration date. UseResponse API: GET /users/{id}.json.

tools.name: useresponse_get_user_activity
tools.description: List the tickets and topics one user created. UseResponse API: GET /users/{id}/activity.json.

tools.name: useresponse_list_user_custom_fields
tools.description: List the custom fields defined for users. UseResponse API: GET /users/custom-fields/list.json.

tools.name: useresponse_list_categories
tools.description: List the categories for tickets or topics. UseResponse API: GET /categories.json.

tools.name: useresponse_list_statuses
tools.description: List the statuses that tickets and topics can have. UseResponse API: GET /statuses.json.

tools.name: useresponse_list_forums
tools.description: List the communities (forums) of the account. UseResponse API: GET /forums.json.

tools.name: useresponse_list_reports
tools.description: List the saved reports of the account. UseResponse API: GET /reports/list.json.

tools.name: useresponse_get_report_objects
tools.description: Get the rows of one saved report, with sorting, grouping and paging. UseResponse API: GET /report/{id}/objects.json.

tools.name: useresponse_list_chats
tools.description: List the live chats of the account. UseResponse API: GET /chats.json.

tools.name: useresponse_get_chat
tools.description: Get one live chat by its external id. UseResponse API: GET /chats/{external_id}.json.

tools.name: useresponse_get_chat_messages
tools.description: Get the messages of one live chat. UseResponse API: GET /chats/{external_id}/messages.json.

tools.name: useresponse_create_object
tools.description: Create a new ticket or topic (no attachments). Visible to customers once created. UseResponse API: POST /objects.json.

tools.name: useresponse_create_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a ticket or topic. A private note is visible to staff only. Visible to customers unless is_private is 1. UseResponse API: POST /comments.json.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: useresponse_search_objects, useresponse_list_tickets, useresponse_get_object, useresponse_get_object_comments, useresponse_list_comments, useresponse_get_object_changelog, useresponse_list_object_custom_fields, useresponse_search_users, useresponse_get_user_activity, useresponse_list_categories, useresponse_list_statuses, useresponse_list_chats, useresponse_get_chat, useresponse_get_chat_messages · Private data: useresponse_get_current_user, useresponse_create_comment · Public sink: useresponse_list_tickets, useresponse_search_users, useresponse_create_object, useresponse_create_comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: useresponse_search_objects, useresponse_list_tickets, useresponse_get_object, useresponse_get_object_comments, useresponse_list_comments, useresponse_get_object_changelog, useresponse_list_object_custom_fields, useresponse_search_users, useresponse_get_user_activity, useresponse_list_categories, useresponse_list_statuses, useresponse_list_chats, useresponse_get_chat, useresponse_get_chat_messages · Private data: useresponse_get_current_user, useresponse_create_comment · Public sink: useresponse_list_tickets, useresponse_search_users, useresponse_create_object, useresponse_create_comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
